name: HMAC Generator
description: Compute message authentication codes with HMAC-SM3 or the HMAC-SHA family.

examples.label: Compute HMAC-SM3
examples.value: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

examples.label: Compute HMAC-SHA256
examples.value: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

hints.key: The key and the message are interpreted with their own encodings; a mismatch yields a different result.
hints.algorithm: HMAC-MD5 and HMAC-SHA1 are based on weak digests and must not be used for security.

faq.q: Why does my value differ from the peer?
faq.a: Check the algorithm, the key encoding, the message encoding and the output case.

faq.q: Must the HMAC key be secret?
faq.a: Yes. Once the key leaks, authentication codes can be forged.
